### Sources & Logs Inspected
- **Generic**: [`OppositeIncidenceSpreadSlots.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeIncidenceSpreadSlots.lean), [`Family.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeIncidenceSpreadFamily.lean), reused `OppositeGQ35Spread{Generic,Walks,LowerGeneric}`.
- **Instance**: `OppositeGQ44Spread{Definitions,Incidence,InputInterface,InputRow00,Inputs,Exact}.lean`.
- **Receipts**: [`CHECKPOINT_B.md`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/retained_edge_transfer/opposite_gq44_spread25/formalization/CHECKPOINT_B.md), [`OppositeGQ44SpreadExact.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/retained_edge_transfer/opposite_gq44_spread25/formalization/OppositeGQ44SpreadExact.log), [`OppositeGQ44SpreadAudit.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/retained_edge_transfer/opposite_gq44_spread25/formalization/OppositeGQ44SpreadAudit.log).

### Connection & Interface Audit
- **Neighbor Slots**: [`slot`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ35SpreadSlots.lean#L11) re-routes the diagonal flag $(p,l)$ to the unique bonus vertex `.inr (owner p)`. Under hypothesis `howner`, every graph edge has a preimage in $\text{Fin } a \times \text{Fin } b$; slot non-injectivity is harmless for [`degree_le_of_cover`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ35SpreadSlots.lean#L55).
- **Projection Bridge**: [`ProjectionIndexCheck`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadInputInterface.lean#L8) provides three `Fin 5` indices; kernel verification of the single equality plus [`pointLine_sound`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadIncidence.lean#L11) strictly witnesses original [`Inc`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean#L17) without external geometry assumptions.
- **Hypotheses & Non-Vacuity**: Generic [`order_degree_and_exact_D3`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeIncidenceSpreadFamily.lean#L48) is conditional on $0 < a$, `pointLine_covers`, `spread_unique`, `projection`, and $1+ab+(ab)^2 < |V|$. At concrete $a=b=5$, $|V|=7242$, all premises are soundly discharged via `decide` and all 85 checked row modules.
- **Conditional vs Unconditional**: The generic family interface is an abstract conditional theorem; [`final_claim`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadExact.lean#L14) in `Exact.lean` is a closed, unconditional theorem proving [`FinalClaim`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean#L30) using only standard Lean 4 axioms (`propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`).

### Verdict
- **Gaps / Counterexamples**: None found.
- **Scope Verdict**: **PASS** for Checkpoint B.
- **Remaining Requirement**: Independent, fresh Final-C review.
